title: Chapter 19 Revision — Formal Register
description: Mixed revision quiz covering Pan/Pani address, formal letter structure, formal vs informal vocabulary, and register comparison from Chapter 19.

questions.prompt: Formal question to a woman: Skąd ___ pochodzi? (Where are you from?)
questions.explanation: Formal address to a woman: 'Pani' + 3rd person singular. 'Skąd Pani pochodzi?' = Where are you from? (to a woman). To a man: 'Skąd Pan pochodzi?'

questions.prompt: Formal greeting to a mixed group of people:
questions.explanation: 'Dzień dobry Państwu!' = Good morning, ladies and gentlemen! 'Państwo' = formal mixed plural; dative 'Państwu' used in greetings. 'Panowie' = gentlemen only. 'Hej' and 'Cześć' are informal.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal salutation for an email to an unknown woman:
questions.explanation: 'Szanowna Pani,' = Dear Madam — standard formal salutation to a woman. 'Szanowny Pan' = Dear Sir (to a man). 'Droga Pani' is semi-formal. 'Hej' is very informal.

questions.prompt: Complete the formal request: Uprzejmie proszę o ___ rezerwacji. (I kindly request confirmation of the reservation.)
questions.explanation: 'Uprzejmie proszę o + accusative (noun)': proszę o potwierdzenie (accusative of potwierdzenie, n). Note: proszę o + noun, not proszę + infinitive (which would be a direct polite request).

questions.prompt: What is the standard formal closing for a Polish letter?
questions.explanation: 'Z poważaniem' = Yours faithfully/Sincerely — the most formal and standard closing. 'Pozdrawiam' is semi-formal (used in emails to people you know). 'Do widzenia' = Goodbye (spoken). 'Pa pa' = very informal.
'Otrzymać' = to receive (formal). 'Dostać' = to get (informal). In formal writing: 'Otrzymałem Pańską wiadomość' (I received your message). Never 'Dostałem' in formal correspondence.

questions.prompt: Formal way to say 'I can't come because I'm sick':
options: Nie będę w stanie przybyć ze względu na chorobę.
Nie mogę przyjść, bo jestem chory.
questions.explanation: Most formal: 'Nie będę w stanie przybyć ze względu na chorobę.' Uses: 'nie będę w stanie' (formal inability), 'przybyć' (formal arrive), 'ze względu na' (formal due to). All others are informal or semi-formal.
'Ze względu na + accusative' = due to / owing to (formal reason). 'Ze względu na chorobę' = due to illness. Informal equivalent: 'bo' (because). Very common in formal apologies and refusals.
'Uprzejmie' = kindly / politely (adverb). From 'uprzejmy' (polite). Core formal word: 'Uprzejmie proszę o...' = I kindly request... Used to soften any formal request.

questions.prompt: What does 'w załączeniu' mean in a formal email?
questions.explanation: 'W załączeniu' = attached / enclosed (in email/letter). 'W załączeniu przesyłam moje CV' = Please find my CV attached. From 'załączyć' = to attach.

questions.prompt: Formal version of 'Czy możesz mi pomóc?' (Can you help me?)
questions.explanation: 'Czy Pan może mi pomóc?' = formal version (to a man). Uses 'Pan' + 3rd singular 'może' (not 'możesz'). 'Pani mogłabyś' is a grammar error (mixing formal Pan/Pani with informal ty-form). 'Proszę mi pomóc' = polite but direct, not full formal address.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'to submit (a formal application)' in Polish?
questions.explanation: 'Złożyć' (perf) / 'składać' (imperf) = to submit / lodge (formal). 'Złożyć wniosek' = to submit an application. 'Złożyć skargę' = to lodge a complaint. Key formal administrative verb.
